heading_path: Division 3—Matters pending immediately before repeal of repealed Act
252  Action for infringement of trade mark etc.
text: Sections 62 to 67 and section 78 of the repealed Act continue to apply in relation to an action for the infringement of a trade mark that was pending immediately before 1 January 1996.
